# Find Target Indices After Sorting Array

| Platform | LeetCode |

| Language | python3 |
| URL | [https://leetcode.com/problems/find-target-indices-after-sorting-array/](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-target-indices-after-sorting-array/) |
| Submitted | 2026-10-19T15:01:45.000Z |


## Solution

```python
class Solution:
    def targetIndices(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> list[int]:
        nums.sort()
        return [i for i in range(len(nums)) if nums[i] == target]
```
